## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a server-driven form renderer with offline resilience, a common real-world need in apps like Instacart.

## Key Concepts
- JSON schema-driven UI, basic validators, conditional visibility
- State management for forms and per-field errors
- Offline persistence (AsyncStorage) and schema versioning
- JS-only API surface for rapid iteration

## Code Example
```javascript
// sample DynamicForm usage
```
